mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, type, title, content, actor_id, event_id, group_id, comment_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{actorId}, #{eventId}, #{groupId}, #{commentId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
SELECT MAX(notification_id) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET read_at = NOW() WHERE notification_id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
UPDATE notification n SET n.read_at = NOW() WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.read_at IS NULL AND n.type IN ('COMMENT', 'COMMENT_REPLY')
mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id, e.event_id, e.title, e.location, e.start_time, e.end_time FROM notification n JOIN schedule_event e ON e.event_id = n.event_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.type = 'EVENT_REMINDER' AND n.read_at IS NULL AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND e.start_time > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE ORDER BY e.start_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, type, title, content, event_id) SELECT p.user_id, 'EVENT_REMINDER', CONCAT('「', e.title, '」', #{minutes}, ' 分钟内开始'), CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(e.start_time, '%H:%i'), ' - ', DATE_FORMAT(e.end_time, '%H:%i'), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', e.location), '')), e.event_id FROM event_participant p JOIN schedule_event e ON e.event_id = p.event_id WHERE p.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND e.start_time > NOW() AND e.start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notification n WHERE n.type = 'EVENT_REMINDER' AND n.event_id = e.event_id AND n.user_id = p.user_id AND n.created_at >= e.start_time - INTERVAL (#{minutes} + 1) MINUTE)
